title: Instruction-level compares of residual both-sides QEMU RUN FAILs after typo-RAM widen
scope: Emulator/harness only. Compared already-built orig/cand QEMU-ARC ELFs under build/em-ctl/w/widen_retry_failed2 (and widen_batch_ae for native_stack_check). docker arc-elf32-objdump -d, one batch, opencfw/iar-base:10.10.2-local. No hardware flash, no git commit, no official-app overwrite, other streams left alone. source_completeness_proven stays false.

method.tool: vendor-cache arc-elf32-objdump -d and nm -n via docker opencfw/iar-base:10.10.2-local --platform linux/amd64
normalization: Compare the named function's objdump body (next symbol bounds; native_stack_check's actual body is the first 6 instructions — later unsyboled TU code is in the same dump range on both sides)
Treat mov typo-RAM; ld/st [reg,0] as equivalent to ld/st [absolute typo-RAM]
Treat add base; ld [r] as equivalent to ld [r, base] and object-base + field-offset as equivalent to an orig field literal inside that typo-RAM object
Ignore register allocation, enter_s save-set size, and branch displacements that shrink when an absolute st/ld becomes a register form
Compare callee symbol sets from objdump comments and typo-RAM (0x800000-0x80FFFF) immediate sets

verdict: No residual both-sides RUN FAIL is a demonstrated C mismatch. All 18 functions have identical callee-symbol sets. Line-level INST_DIFF on every function is expected: typo-RAM symbol refs compile to mov+ld/st or base+offset, not the orig absolute [0xADDR] form, and that cascades register allocation. After folding, 10 are same typo-RAM immediates (4 of those also hand-reviewed as fully semantic-equivalent). The other 8 are object-base vs field-address (or orig table-stride / just-past-object literals vs cand base+offset). Both-sides QEMU RUN FAILs remain harness/environment (timeouts, decoder asserts, SP outside the 4 KiB window, AUX/kflag MMIO spin).

functions.name: opencfw_em9305_native_stack_check_302820
functions.insn_count: actual body 6 insns (objdump range also swallows later unsyboled TU code)
functions.note: C is sp=__builtin_stack_address()-4; brk if sp is outside &em9305_ram_80e978..&em9305_ram_80f978 (orig used the same 0x80e978/0x80f978 literals). Orig folds to add r0,sp,0xff7f1684 (= raw_sp-0x80e97c); cmp 0x1000; jls blink; brk. Cand is sub2 r0,sp,1 (=raw_sp-4); cmp 0x80e978 / 0x80f978; jls/brk. Effective raw-SP window is [0x80e97c, 0x80f97c] on both sides. Harness SP is outside that window, so both sides still brk and cannot be memhashed here.

Not treated as a C mismatch; object-map coverage is slightly short of a few orig field addresses.
